title: Vengeance
order_note: Sorted by recording id: C (cinematics), M (in-engine cutscenes), T (gameplay transmissions); unit barks follow their trigger group. Interleaving of C/M/T is not confirmed.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: Look at what Arthas left in his wake. How many more cities will he burn? How many lives will he claim?
lines.raw: ["Surprised" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]Look at what Arthas left in his wake. How many more cities will he burn? How many lives will he claim?[/"Surprised"]

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Rivendare is the one who set this in motion. We're going to end him here and now.
lines.raw: ["Angry" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]Rivendare is the one who set this in motion. We're going to end him here and now.[/"Angry"]

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: Indeed. The city will be well fortified, but I can enter the side gate and raise the portcullises.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: A sound plan. Stay safe until we can regroup with you.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: And you, Garek. May the Light guide your blade.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Rivendare! You will answer for your crimes with your death!
lines.raw: ["Angry" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]Rivendare! You will answer for your crimes with your death![/"Angry"]

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Baron Rivendare
lines.text: Death? What do you know of death?
lines.raw: ["Happy" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]Death? What do you know of death?[/"Happy"]

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Baron Rivendare
lines.text: I have seen and wielded its true power! The Lich King has exalted me above foolish weaklings like you!

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Baron Rivendare
lines.text: Now I will draw the screams out of you, as I did with your pathetic captain!
lines.raw: ["Angry" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]Now I will draw the screams out of you, as I did with your pathetic captain![/"Angry"]

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: You don't deserve to speak his name! Die like the vermin you are! For Landen!
lines.raw: ["Angry" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]You don't deserve to speak his name! Die like the vermin you are! For Landen![/"Angry"]

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Baron.Transmission Baron Entrance GrainShipments Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text:
Crates of grain, infected with the plague. This is how Rivendare 
doomed his people.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Baron.Transmission Baron Entrance InnerGate Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The gate is locked. We’ll have to wait for Ilastar to open it.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Baron.Transmission Baron Ramparts Alonsus Chapel
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: Alonsus Chapel. What sacrilege have the cult inflicted upon it?

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Baron.Transmission Baron Entrance HouseZombies1 Q
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: The way is open. I will remain up here and scout ahead.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Baron.Transmission Baron Entrance MortarTeam Rescue Q
lines.speaker: Mortar Team
lines.text: Are you... alive? Thank the Light! We’ve been surrounded by the Scourge for weeks!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Baron.Transmission Baron Ramparts AttackedBySpiritTower Q
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: I can’t face them alone. Garek’s mortar teams can help from afar.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Plague Mushrooms.Transmission Mush Discover Q
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: By the Light! The spores from those mushrooms are spreading the plague. They cannot be allowed to grow!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Plague Mushrooms.Transmission Mush Completed Q
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: Let these vile spores choke on the ashes of this ruined city.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Baron.Transmission Baron Ramparts RiflemenBarricades Q
lines.speaker: Rifleman
lines.text: Reinforcements! I told ye we just had to hang on a little longer!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Baron.Transmission Baron Entrance CryptAttacked Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Focus on the Crypt, before it makes short work of us!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Baron.Transmission Baron Entrance HeroesAtGate Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Ilastar, how do you fare?

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Baron.Transmission Baron Entrance HeroesAtGate Q
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: Well enough. I will heal you as best as I can from up here.

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Ras Frostwhisper
lines.text: The cowardly mages of the Kirin Tor spurned my talent and ambition. But the Lich King will reward it!

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Ras Frostwhisper
lines.text: I now cast aside this wretched flesh and blood, and embrace the immortality of undeath!

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Ras Frostwhisper
lines.text: Behold! I arise anew, perfected in form and power!

lines.scene: Initialization.Dialogue Reference
lines.speaker: Ras Frostwhisper
lines.text: Leonid! Tell my students to do as they wish. A greater destiny awaits me now!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Baron.Transmission Baron Ras Gate Open Q1
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The gate’s still closed. There must be a second lever.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Baron.Transmission Baron Ras Gate Open Q2
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: The gate remains shut. There must be another lever.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Baron.Transmission Baron Ras Gate Open Real Ilastar Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The gates are open! Frostwhisper will taste our steel!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Baron.Transmission Baron Ras Gate Open Real Garek Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The gates are open! Frostwhisper will taste our steel!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Boss.Transmission Boss Ras Attacked Q
lines.speaker: Ras Frostwhisper
lines.text: Ah, back for more, are you? This time I will flay you alive!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Boss.Transmission Boss Ras Dies Q
lines.speaker: Ras Frostwhisper
lines.text: You cannot kill me so easily, mortals. We will meet again.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Boss.Transmission Boss Ras Dies Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Forget about him. Our true target is Rivendare.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Baron.Transmission Baron Passage CivilianSaved1 Q NOT USED
lines.speaker: Citizen
lines.text: You've saved my life! I need to get out of here!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Baron.Transmission Baron Passage CivilianSaved2 Q NOT USED
lines.speaker: Citizen
lines.text: Thank you, kind sir! I thought I would die in there, or worse!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Baron.Transmission Baron Passage CivilianSaved3 Q NOT USED
lines.speaker: Citizen
lines.text: Can it be? Is the nightmare over? I can't thank you enough!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Harbor Salvage.Transmission Harbor Discover Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It looks like some tried to flee Stratholme by sea. The cult must have sunk their ship.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Harbor Salvage.Transmission Harbor Discover Q
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: We should recover their supplies. They can aid the war effort.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Harbor Salvage.Transmission Harbor Completed Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Those should be enough supplies. Time to get back to land.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Baron.Transmission Baron Passage ZombieHorde Q
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: The streets are infested with the undead. Best avoid them if we can.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Baron.Transmission Baron Passage ZombieHordeAttack Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Here they come! Be ready to fight!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Baron.Transmission Baron Passage CrusaderGate Locked Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The gate’s locked. We won’t get through without a key.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Baron.Transmission Baron Passage CrusaderGate Enter Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The road to Crusader’s Square is open. Rivendare can’t hide forever.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Baron.Transmission Baron Passage ThereWasADemon Q NOT USED
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It was a demon! Wings and horns and cloven feet!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Boss.Transmission Boss Lorthiras Attacked Q
lines.speaker: Lorthiras
lines.text: Your suffering will be exquisite.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Boss.Transmission Boss Lorthiras Dies Q
lines.speaker: Lorthiras
lines.text: This is not the end, little mortals.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Baron.Transmission Baron Passage CrusaderSquareProper Gate Enter Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Stratholme was one of the greatest cities in Lordaeron. Then Rivendare sacrificed it to the undead!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Baron.Transmission Baron Passage CrusaderSquareProper Gate Enter Q
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: He is but one of many to sell his soul to the Scourge. They will all burn in holy fire.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Baron.Transmission Baron Upper KnightsRescue Q
lines.speaker: Knight
lines.text: More survivors! Hold the line!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Baron.Transmission Baron Passage TrapGate Enter Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Damn, our forces have been split. We need to find the lever that opens the gate.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Baron.Transmission Baron Passage TrapGate LeverKill Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Let's regroup and press forward.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Baron.Transmission Baron Upper CiviliansHostileMeet Q NOT USED
lines.speaker: Citizen
lines.text: We're trapped! Please, help us!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Baron.Transmission Baron Upper CiviliansHostileConvert Q NOT USED
lines.speaker: Citizen
lines.text: Death to Lordaeron!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Baron.Transmission Baron Upper CiviliansHostileSlain Q NOT USED
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Such is the fate of all cultists.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Boss.Transmission Boss Skeletons Attacked Q
lines.speaker: Grimthane
lines.text: Your bones will serve the Scourge.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Boss.Transmission Boss Skeletons Dead Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Now your bones can join the rest.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Baron.Transmission Baron Slaughterhouse EnterGate Q
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: Here is the profane tower where Rivendare holds court.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Baron.Transmission Baron Slaughterhouse EnterGate Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: I’ll throw him from the parapets once I’ve cut him down.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Baron.Transmission Baron Slaughterhouse EnterSlaughterhouse Q
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: Garek, there could still be survivors throughout the city.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Baron.Transmission Baron Slaughterhouse EnterSlaughterhouse Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Our soldiers can keep searching for civilians in need of rescue.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Baron.Transmission Baron Slaughterhouse EnterSlaughterhouse Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We’ll regroup in Hearthglen when the deed is done. Now, let’s bring Rivendare to justice.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Boss.Transmission Boss Rivendare Start Q
lines.speaker: Baron Rivendare
lines.text: You will all serve me!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Boss.Transmission Boss Rivendare Endless Q
lines.speaker: Baron Rivendare
lines.text: The Scourge's numbers are endless! You will drown in your own blood!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Boss.Transmission Boss Rivendare Gas Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: What... is this? It's in my lungs...

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Boss.Transmission Boss Rivendare Gas Q
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: Plague spores... we... we're infected...

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Boss.Transmission Boss Rivendare Obelisks Q
lines.speaker: Baron Rivendare
lines.text: Annoying pests! Witness true power!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Boss.Transmission Boss Rivendare Obelisks Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Ilastar, the obelisks! Destroy them!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Boss.Transmission Boss Rivendare Cant Q NOT USED
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: I... can't...

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Boss.Transmission Boss Rivendare Cant Q NOT USED
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Hold on, Ilastar!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Baron.Transmission Captured 01 Rescue Rack Q
lines.speaker: Footman
lines.text: For Lordaeron!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Baron.Transmission Captured 04 Rescue Rack Q
lines.speaker: Footman
lines.text: To arms!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Rescued Units.Transmission Baron Ramparts CagedSorceress Q
lines.speaker: Sorceress
lines.text: Now victory shall be ours!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Rescued Units.Transmission Baron Ramparts CagedFootman Q
lines.speaker: Footman
lines.text: It's only a flesh wound...

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Rescued Units.Transmission Baron Ramparts CagedPriest Q
lines.speaker: Priest
lines.text: I come to cleanse this land.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Rescued Units.Transmission Baron Ramparts CagedRifleman Q
lines.speaker: Rifleman
lines.text: Locked and loaded!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Rescued Units.Transmission Baron Ramparts CagedMotarTeam Q
lines.speaker: Mortar Team
lines.text: Let's get to fightin'!
